title: Meeting a New Coworker
scene: 新しい同僚と初めて会う
lines: Hi, you must be Ken. I'm Anna from the marketing team.
Nice to meet you, Anna. Yes, I just started today.
Welcome! How is your first day going so far?
Pretty well, thanks. Everyone has been very kind.
That's good to hear. Which team are you on?
I'm in sales. I'll be working with the Asian market.
Oh, great. Then we'll probably work together on some projects.
I hope so. I still have a lot to learn about our products.
Don't worry. If you have any questions, just send me a message.
By the way, some of us have lunch together on Fridays. Would you like to join?
I'd love to. Thanks for asking.

questions.q: Which team is Ken on?
What does Anna invite Ken to do?

title: Scheduling a Meeting
lines: Yuki, do you have a minute? I'd like to set up a meeting about the new website.
Tuesday is difficult for me. I'm visiting a client all afternoon.
I see. What about Wednesday morning, then?
Wednesday at ten works for me.
Great. It should take about an hour. I'll invite Sam from the design team, too.
Good idea. Should I prepare anything?
Could you bring the latest numbers on website visits?
No problem. I'll send them to you before the meeting.
Perfect. I'll send a calendar invitation this afternoon.

questions.q: Why is Tuesday difficult for Yuki?
options: She has another meeting with Sam

questions.q: What will Yuki bring to the meeting?
options: The latest numbers on website visits

title: A Phone Call to a Supplier
lines: Good morning, Green Office Supplies. How can I help you?
Good morning. This is Taro Sato from Blue Sky Travel. May I speak to Mr. Brown, please?
One moment, please. I'll put you through.
Hi, Mr. Brown. I'm calling about our order from last week. Order number 4-5-2.
Let me check. Yes, I have it here. Is there a problem?
We received the chairs, but two of them are the wrong color.
I'm very sorry about that. We'll send the correct ones right away.
Thank you. When can we expect them?
They should arrive by Thursday. Please keep the wrong ones, and our driver will pick them up.
That's great. Thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Again, sorry for the trouble.

questions.q: What was wrong with the order?
options: Two chairs were the wrong color

questions.q: What will happen to the wrong chairs?
options: The driver will pick them up
Taro will send them by post

title: Asking for Help
lines: Mike, are you busy right now?
I'm trying to make a chart in this spreadsheet, and I can't get it right.
Let me take a look. What do you want the chart to show?
Monthly sales for each region, from January to June.
OK. First, select the data, including the names of the months.
Yes. Now click Insert, and choose the line chart.
Oh, that's much better! I was using the wrong type of chart.
A line chart is good for showing changes over time.
Thanks so much. I owe you a coffee.
Anytime. And I'll take that coffee!

questions.q: What does Lisa want the chart to show?
Why is a line chart good here, according to Mike?
options: It is the easiest to print

title: Checking In at a Hotel
scene: 出張先のホテルでチェックイン
lines: Good evening. Welcome to the Harbor Hotel. Do you have a reservation?
Yes, I do. The name is Saki Tanaka.
Thank you. Let me see. Yes, a single room for three nights.
Yes, it is. Breakfast is served from six thirty to ten on the second floor.
Great. Also, is there a place where I can print some documents?
We have a business center next to the lobby. It's open twenty-four hours.
Perfect. And what time is checkout?
Checkout is at eleven. If you need a late checkout, please let us know.
Here is your key card. Your room is 815. Enjoy your stay.

questions.q: How long is Saki staying?
Where can Saki print documents?
options: At the business center next to the lobby

title: A Project Delay
scene: 上司にプロジェクトの遅れを報告する
lines: Mr. Clark, do you have five minutes? I need to talk to you about the app project.
I'm afraid we're behind schedule. We won't be able to finish by the end of this month.
I see. What's causing the delay?
The payment system is more complex than we expected. We found some security problems during testing.
Security is important. How much more time do you need?
About two weeks. I've prepared a new schedule.
Thank you for telling me early. Can we release part of the app on time?
Yes. We could release everything except the payment system this month.
Good. Let's do that. Please send the new schedule to the client today.
I will. Thank you for understanding.

questions.q: What is causing the delay?
options: The payment system is more complex than expected

questions.q: What do they decide to do?
options: Release everything except the payment system this month

title: Ordering at a Business Lunch
scene: 取引先との昼食で注文する
lines: Jun, have you decided? The fish here is very good.
Then I'll have the fish, please. Does it come with rice?
It comes with potatoes, but we can change that to rice.
And I'll have the chicken salad. Could I have the dressing on the side?
Very good. I'll be right back with your drinks.
So, Jun, how was your flight from Osaka?
It was smooth, thanks. I even slept a little.

questions.q: What does Jun order?
Where did Jun fly from?

title: A Customer Complaint
scene: お客様の苦情に対応する
lines: Hello. I bought this coffee machine here last week, and it already stopped working.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Could you tell me what happened?
It turns on, but no water comes out.
I see. Do you have the receipt with you?
Thank you. It's under warranty, so we can repair it or give you a new one.
How long would a repair take?
That's too long. I use it every morning.
I understand. Then let me get you a new one right now.
You're welcome. Again, I'm sorry for the trouble.

questions.q: What is the problem with the coffee machine?
What does the customer get in the end?

title: Small Talk Before a Meeting
lines: Kenta, good to see you again. How have you been?
Very well, thanks. Busy, but good. How about you?
Same here. We just moved into a new office.
Oh, really? How do you like it?
It's great. It's much brighter, and it's close to the station.
That sounds nice. Did you have a good weekend?
Yes, I went hiking with my family. The weather was perfect.
Lucky you. It rained all weekend in Tokyo.
Oh no. Did you do anything fun inside?
I watched a few movies and finally cleaned my apartment.
That's productive! Well, shall we get started?

questions.q: What does Sarah like about the new office?
options: It is brighter and close to the station

questions.q: What was the weather like in Tokyo on the weekend?

title: Negotiating a Price
lines: Thank you for the quote. Your product is excellent, but the price is higher than our budget.
I understand. What price did you have in mind?
We were hoping for around ten percent less.
Ten percent is difficult. But if you order a larger amount, we can lower the price.
How large would the order need to be?
If you order five hundred units instead of three hundred, we can offer eight percent off.
Five hundred is a lot for us. Could we order five hundred but receive them in two deliveries?
That should be possible. Three hundred now and two hundred in three months?
That works. And could we pay for each delivery separately?
Yes, I think we can agree to that.
Great. Please send us a new quote with those terms.

questions.q: What discount does the seller offer for a larger order?
How will the products be delivered?

title: A Job Interview
lines: Thank you for coming today, Ryo. Could you tell me a little about yourself?
Of course. I studied economics at university, and for the last three years I've worked in sales at an electronics company.
Why are you interested in this position?
I'd like to work with international customers. Your company sells in over thirty countries, and I want to use my English.
Can you tell me about a time you solved a difficult problem?
Last year, one of our biggest customers was unhappy with late deliveries. I visited them, found out the cause, and worked with our warehouse to fix it. They increased their orders by twenty percent.
That's impressive. What is your biggest weakness?
Sometimes I try to do everything myself. I'm learning to ask my team for help earlier.
Good. Do you have any questions for us?
Yes. What does success look like in the first year in this role?
Good question. Mainly, building strong relationships with our key customers in Asia.

questions.q: Why is Ryo interested in the position?
options: He wants to work with international customers
He wants to work from home

questions.q: What does Ryo say is his weakness?
options: He tries to do everything himself

title: At the Airport
lines: Good morning. Where are you flying today?
Thank you. Are you checking any bags?
Please put it on the scale. Would you like a window or an aisle seat?
An aisle seat, please. It's a long flight.
All right. Here is your boarding pass. Boarding starts at ten fifteen at gate 34.
Yes, it is. Have a nice flight.

questions.q: Where is Kazu flying?
Which seat does Kazu want?

title: Giving Feedback
scene: 部下にフィードバックする
lines: Tom, thanks for your presentation to the client yesterday. Can I share some feedback?
First, your slides were very clear. The client said the charts were easy to understand.
Thank you. I worked hard on them.
It showed. One thing to improve: when the client asked about the price, you looked a little unsure.
Yes, I wasn't ready for that question.
Next time, try to prepare answers for the five most likely questions.
That's a good idea. Could we practice together before the next meeting?
Of course. Let's set up thirty minutes next week.
Thank you. I really appreciate the feedback.

questions.q: What did the client say about the slides?
options: The charts were easy to understand

questions.q: What does the manager suggest Tom do next time?
options: Prepare answers for the most likely questions

title: Booking a Meeting Room
lines: Hi, I'd like to book a meeting room for tomorrow afternoon.
Sure. How many people will there be?
Eight, including two visitors from outside the company.
Room B on the fifth floor is free from one to four. It has a large screen.
That's perfect. We only need it from two to three thirty.
OK. Do you need a video connection?
Yes, one person will join online from Singapore.
No problem. Do you need anything else? Coffee or water?
Water would be nice. And could you register the two visitors at reception?
Of course. Please send me their names by email.
I'll do that right away. Thanks.

questions.q: How many people will be at the meeting?
Why do they need a video connection?
options: One person will join from Singapore
They want to record the meeting

title: Asking for a Deadline Extension
scene: 締め切りの延長をお願いする
lines: Mr. Davis, I'm sorry to bother you. Could I ask about the market report?
Sure. It's due on Friday, right?
Yes. I wanted to ask if I could have until next Tuesday.
We just received new data from the survey company. If I include it, the report will be much more accurate.
I see. When do you think you can finish?
I can send a draft on Monday and the final version on Tuesday morning.
That should be fine. The board meeting is on Thursday, so Tuesday is the latest.
Understood. I'll make sure it's ready by Tuesday morning.
Thanks for letting me know early.

questions.q: Why does Mei want more time?
options: She wants to include new survey data

questions.q: When is the board meeting?

title: An Online Meeting Problem
scene: オンライン会議の不具合
lines: Yes, but your voice is breaking up a little.
Sorry about that. Is it better now?
Yes, much better. But I can't see your screen.
Oh, I forgot to share it. One moment. Can you see it now?
Yes, I can see the sales chart.
Great. Wait, someone just joined. Who's that?
I think it's Peter. Peter, you're on mute.
Still no sound. Let's continue, and I'll send him the notes later.
Good idea. Shall we start with last month's results?

questions.q: What was the first problem?
Why could they not hear Peter?

title: Introducing a Product
scene: 展示会で製品を紹介する
lines: Excuse me, what is this product?
It's a smart water bottle. It reminds you to drink water during the day.
It connects to your phone. If you haven't had water for an hour, the bottle lights up.
Interesting. How long does the battery last?
About two weeks on one charge.
And how much does it cost?
It's forty-five dollars in stores. For business customers, there are discounts for large orders.
I work for a gym chain. We might be interested in selling it to our members.
That would be a great fit. May I have your business card? I'll send you more information.

questions.q: What does the bottle do if you have not had water for an hour?
Where does the visitor work?

title: Talking About Sales Results
scene: 売上の結果について話す
lines: Keiko, have you seen the numbers for the third quarter?
Yes. Overall sales were up five percent compared to last year.
That's good. Which products did best?
Our new tablets. They sold almost twice as many as we expected.
Great. And were there any weak areas?
Sales in Europe fell by about three percent. Two big customers reduced their orders.
One of them is moving to a cheaper supplier. The other is cutting costs because of the economy.
Let's discuss a plan for Europe at Monday's meeting.

questions.q: How did overall sales change?
Where did sales fall?
